text:
maya: Support flagged a couple of docs regressions after yesterday's deploy: pricing anchors 404 and metering header snippets are out of date. can someone pick this up?
sasha: on it. which anchors 404?
maya: /pricing#usage-tiers and /pricing#burst-credits both return 404 now (dashboard panel rename). also /docs/metering/headers.md still shows Authorization: Bearer <KEY> and examples call generateText().
jonathan: we moved panel ids to consumption-* last sprint. fix options: add redirects.yml entries or update anchors in-page. i prefer redirects so external links keep working.
liam: add a redirect + a small unit test to assert the redirect exists. last time that test was flaky so please run locally first.
emily: support wants a concise burst example. proposal: "Burst formula: burst_minutes * burst_rate_per_min -> tokens used. Example: 15min * 1,000 tokens/min = 15,000 tokens consumed from burst quota." put a one-line python helper too.
sasha: drafting PR: will update anchors, add redirects.yml entries, swap SDK snippets to client.generate(...) usage and show headers as { 'x-api-key': RW_KEY }, include the burst example + tiny python helper, add migration blurb under /docs/migration/headers.md, and backport to docs-1.3 branch after main merge.
docs-bot: PR #4398 opened by sasha — "docs: pricing anchors + metering header snippets + redirects". Reviewers requested: @jonathan, @emily. CI: queued.
maya: thanks. ping when CI is green and i'll do a quick QA pass in staging. :thumbsup:
jonathan: small nit for TS snippet: use await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: '...' }, { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } }). avoid legacy method names.
sasha: will update and push. aiming to merge today.
